Welcome to Canada's Largest Social Innovation Community

Members of the Centre for Social Innovation work across sectors to create a better world. We accelerate their success and amplify their impact through the power of coworking, community, and collaboration. Together, we’re building a movement to put people and planet first.

Want to know the full story? It all starts at Who We Are →

CSI is home to over 3,000 members across two locations.

CSI has supported over 5,000 social impact organizations since launching in 2004.

Our members have a combined annual revenue of over $250M.

We have Everything our members need to thrive

Workspace, community and reach created and curated with intention for and by today's changemakers.

Space

CSI is internationally recognized as a pioneer in the creation of shared coworking spaces for social innovation in Canada and beyond. We offer flexible hot desk packages right up to fully equipped offices with all the perks.

Find Coworking or Meeting Space →

Community

We know the importance of building lasting relationships and strong networks. Our curated events and initiatives create ongoing opportunities for CSI members to come together, share, collaborate, and make change online and offline.

See our Community Events →

Reach

Expand your reach beyond our local community and join a nationwide network of social innovators. Explore inspiring projects, learn about opportunities, find funding, and build collaborations all across the country. It all starts free.

Check out CSI Network Newsletter →
